name: drawer-form
title: Drawer Form
description: A form panel with consumer-supplied fields and cancel and submit actions: a slide-over by default, or with `responsive` a bottom sheet below the large breakpoint and a centred panel above it, kept as one overlay so an open form keeps its values. Composed from Drawer, Form, Button, and Stack.

files.content:
/* DrawerForm.css — .sd-drawerform (Block)
   No declarations by design: arrangement comes from Stack + the Drawer's own body/footer layout,
   and the Components own all chrome and look. The two classes the Block does emit
   (`sd-drawerform`, `sd-drawerform__fields`) are styling hooks for consumers who fork the Block.
   This Block defines no tokens and does not reach into Component internals (block-contract §3, §5). */
